sentences.text: En la casa de doña Reina, todos ayudan con la comida.
sentences.english: In doña Reina's house, everyone helps with the meal.

sentences.text: Doña Reina cocina el pollo.
sentences.english: Doña Reina cooks the chicken.

sentences.text: Don José fríe las tajadas.
sentences.english: Don José fries the tajadas (slices of plantain).

sentences.text: Karla prepara una ensalada y Kevin pone la mesa.
sentences.english: Karla makes a salad and Kevin sets the table.

sentences.text: Llega la abuela, doña Ana, con una bolsa de naranjas.
sentences.english: Grandmother arrives, doña Ana, with a bag of oranges.

sentences.text: —Bienvenida, mamá —dice doña Reina.
sentences.english: "Welcome, Mom," says doña Reina.

sentences.text: —Abuela, ¿quiere sentarse aquí? —pregunta Karla.
sentences.english: "Grandma, would you like to sit here?" asks Karla.

sentences.text: —Gracias, mi hija —dice la abuela.
sentences.english: "Thank you, dear," says Grandma.

sentences.text: La mesa está llena: hay pollo, tajadas, arroz, frijoles, tortillas y ensalada.
sentences.english: The table is full: there is chicken, tajadas, rice, beans, tortillas and salad.

sentences.text: Antes de comer, don José da gracias a Dios.
sentences.english: Before eating, don José gives thanks to God.

sentences.text: —Gracias, Señor, por esta comida y por esta familia —dice.
sentences.english: "Thank you, Lord, for this food and for this family," he says.

sentences.text: Todos dicen: —Amén.
sentences.english: Everyone says, "Amen."

sentences.text: Comen despacio y hablan mucho.
sentences.english: They eat slowly and talk a lot.

sentences.text: La abuela cuenta una historia de cuando ella era niña.
sentences.english: Grandma tells a story from when she was a girl.

sentences.text: —¿Quiere más pollo, abuela? —pregunta Kevin.
sentences.english: "Would you like more chicken, Grandma?" asks Kevin.

sentences.text: —No, gracias, mi hijo. Ya comí mucho —responde la abuela.
sentences.english: "No, thank you, dear. I have eaten a lot," answers Grandma.

sentences.text: Karla sirve jugo de naranja a todos.
sentences.english: Karla serves orange juice to everyone.

sentences.text: Después de comer, doña Reina trae café y pan.
sentences.english: After eating, doña Reina brings coffee and bread.

sentences.text: —Qué rica comida, Reina. Gracias —dice don José.
sentences.english: "What a delicious meal, Reina. Thank you," says don José.

sentences.text: —Gracias a todos por ayudar —dice doña Reina.
sentences.english: "Thank you all for helping," says doña Reina.

sentences.text: Karla y Kevin lavan los platos.
sentences.english: Karla and Kevin wash the dishes.

sentences.text: La abuela se sienta en la sala y sonríe.
sentences.english: Grandma sits down in the living room and smiles.
